message: Field "Rejected.value": native type "@db.VarBit" has no Prisma 8 codec yet, and Prisma 8 cannot read this schema until it supports the column type. @ignore on the field or @@ignore on the model does not help: Prisma 8 keeps the columns of ignored fields and models in the contract. Changing the field's type to one Prisma 8 supports changes the column type on Prisma 7's next migration.
